title: Cadence experiment pocket log
content:
Purpose: quick personal tracker for short cadence experiments (latency vs cost vs quantization) — informal notes, fast table for copying into tickets.

Notes to self:
- Keep runs small (5–10 samples) for quick triage.
- Always record seed + input template version.
- If p95 > SLO, snapshot input + alignment prompts.

Run table (one-line per run, copy to sheet if needed):
Date,Run,Model,Quant,Batch,Seq,Tokens,P50_ms,P95_ms,Cost_per_1k_notes,Label,Seed,Inputs_version,Tags
2024-10-01,R1,redwood-2.7B,8-bit,8,512,4500,62,142,0.015,fast-probe,42,v1.0,"latency,low-cost"
2024-10-01,R2,redwood-2.7B,4-bit,8,512,4500,58,190,0.010,quant-explore,42,v1.0,"latency,quality-check"
2024-10-07,R3,redwood-7B,4-bit,4,1024,8800,120,410,0.036,baseline,11,v1.1,"throughput"
2024-10-15,R4,redwood-7B,8-bit+KVcache,16,256,2200,45,110,0.028,burst,7,v1.1,"burst,cache-test"
2024-10-22,R5,community-13B,8-bit,2,2048,16000,420,980,0.12,quality,99,v1.2,"quality,expensive"

Quick impressions (inline):
- R2 p95 spike likely due to quantization kernel mismatch on A100 slice; need to repeat with p50/p95 sampling larger N.
- R4 shows strong p50 improvement for small seqs with caching — promising for short-chat use cases.
- R3 cost looks high vs latency; consider batching policy change or smaller model.

Ad-hoc checklist: 
- [ ] Re-run R2 with same seed but warm-up 50 requests to fill KV cache
- [ ] File perf profile: flame (INF-782) -> add to PR notes
- [ ] Push a short summary to #serving-runtime after next run

Simple notes for cost calc: 
- cost_per_1k rough calc = (tokens / 1000) * unit_price_estimate (unit price depends on reserved vs hosted).
- For these quick runs assume unit_price_estimate=0.0025 per token for hosted roughs (replace when billing confirmed).

Scratch formulas (copy to sheet cell):
- p95_margin = (P95_ms - P50_ms) / P50_ms
- tokens_per_sec_est = (batch * tokens) / (p50_ms / 1000)

Questions / TODOs (notes-to-self):
- Why does 4-bit on 2.7B sometimes spike p95? check kernel selection logs. (look at /var/log/infer-kernel.log and PR 412 notes)
- Should we pin quant profile per-region? adds complexity but maybe reduces tail variance.

Context links and quick copy snippets: 
- PR for infra tweak: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/412
- Related ticket: JIRA-INF-782 (kernel selection + quant fallback)
- Slack thread: #serving-runtime (search "quant p95 spike")

Free-form brain dump (short):
- If we can get 4-bit stable for 2.7B with batch 8 for common seq lengths (<=512) we can push a cheaper short-chat tier. Need to pair quant profile with KV cache priming and a fallback to 8-bit if p95 exceeds 350ms.

End — snapshot this file into ticket notes; keep as my go-to quick tracker for small experiments.
